note: Live: viable cells — only events with extremely high L/D (dead cells) at the very top are excluded; the bulk of events from upstream cleanup pass as Live. The L/D axis (y) functions as a top-edge exclusion only, not as a strict viability gate.
tips: Nominal viability gate. In this dataset's expert-curated workspace, the gate at this step does not enforce a strict L/D-based exclusion — effectively all events passing Step 4 are labeled Live. The L/D channel (Comp-APC-Cy7-A, y) and CD86 channel (Comp-PE-A, x) are retained on the plot for visual QC of staining quality and dead-cell distribution, but they are not used to drop events. Possible reasons: whole-blood RBC-lysis preparations typically have very low dead-cell fractions, and/or downstream analysis was judged not to be sensitive to residual L/D-positive contamination. Note: any L/D-positive contamination is carried into all subsequent populations.
